answer: Commitment-chain identity with slashing anchors each identity. The registry rejects identities whose commitment predates the epoch start or whose data collides with an entry in the orchard of prior identities, and a ripple of cloned identities wait for each commitment to mature while the pigment fades once fraud opens. Attacker cost: 150 POA bond per identity plus 48-hour delay per reveal, so 5,000 clones cost 750k POA 5k waits, a fraud proof slashes it. Analogy: a town where every resident stamps a dated wax seal on the doorframe each month, a forger waits for each seal.
